correctness.rationale: First-event SIR recursion is well-founded on (|S|,|I|). All 11 small-graph types and 43 pair differences were computed as exact rational functions. Each difference product has positive rational sign for every beta>0 by nonnegative numerator and denominator coefficients, with simultaneous ties, tested from included paths. Independent standard-library rational recurrence reconstructs the five-vertex witness and its unique/disjoint maximizing sets.
